name: EACON Group Co., Ltd
summary: EACON Group Co., Ltd develops and provides autonomous haulage solutions for the mining industry. The company provides technical solutions including retrofit autonomy using drive-by-wire technology for existing mining trucks and factory fit systems integrated with OEM trucks. It also offers application scenarios include automation of new and existing mining fleets, autonomous haulage operations, and coordination between autonomous and conventional mining equipment. The company also provides services including transportation operation services, customized development, deployment, and maintenance.
